none: PAS NLM-4CD983: Roman Coin: Denarius indeterminate
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver Coin. Denarius,of an indeterminate Roman ruler, possibly Antoninus Pius (138-161) or Septimius Severus (193-211), probably mint of Rome. Chipped. Obverse description: Bearded bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [----]II[?C]AVG. Reverse description: Probably Minerva seated left holding spear and extending right hand. Diameter: 17.4mm, Weight: 1.67gms, die axis: 12
